# TalibRoom

> TalibRoom is a free platform that helps university students in Morocco find a roommate, a verified apartment, and a student community — built by a student, for students.

Today, most Moroccan students find housing through unmoderated Facebook groups and torn campus flyers, with no way to verify a listing or a roommate is real. TalibRoom replaces that with verified student profiles matched by lifestyle and budget, real apartment listings, and city-based student communities — the core product is free.

## What it does

- Roommate matching — students create a profile (city, university, budget, lifestyle habits) and get matched with compatible roommates.
- Apartment listings — students and verified real-estate agents post rentals; listings are searchable by city and filtered appropriately for student safety.
- Student communities — city- and university-based feeds, groups, and direct messaging.
- Referral program — students can invite friends via a personal link; invites currently enter a giveaway funded by TalibRoom (not affiliated with or sponsored by Anthropic).

## Who it's for

University students in Morocco looking for a roommate or student housing, and real-estate agents listing apartments for students. Available in Arabic, French, and English.

## Cities

Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Fès, Meknès, Tanger, Agadir, Oujda, Tétouan, El Jadida, Safi, Kénitra, Mohammedia, Béni Mellal, Nador.
